Restore size, lines, sound and interaction settings, remove every baby whale, and move the pet to the bottom of the screen.
%1$d of %2$d right now. Long-press the pet to spawn or remove one; switching this off takes them all down.
Pets push and bounce off each other. A pet you are dragging is not knocked away.
The gap is random between the two values; the longest never falls below the shortest.

Tap sounds use the phone media volume.
Chat without starting the overlay pet. Configure a model service before your first message.

Play a bundled action once in place, then return to idle. Resume first if paused. Taps, dragging and collisions can interrupt playback.
Cannot play now. Resume the pet and finish dragging first.
Animation import is not available yet. Custom animations are planned for a future update.
External plugins are not supported in this version.
Plugin integration and management are planned here. This page does not discover, install or load plugins.
Reply reading uses your device’s speech engine; some voices need a network. Keyboard dictation is handled by your selected keyboard. This app does not record audio.

Off by default. Only newly completed replies are read while this chat is visible. History, failed and interrupted replies are not read automatically. Leaving chat or switching to the background stops playback without resuming.
Selections are saved on this device immediately. Voice names and languages are provided by the system engine.
No installed voices are available to list.
For more voices, install a speech engine and language data in system settings, then reopen chat.
System speech is unavailable. Text chat still works. Install or enable a speech engine, then reopen chat.
The saved voice is unavailable. Using the system default; choose another voice if needed.
Chinese speech data is unavailable. Install Chinese speech data or choose another installed voice.
Speech failed. Check the voice, language data or network. The text reply is retained.
Could not save speech settings. Please retry.
Audio is unavailable right now. Retry with this chat in the foreground.
Hello, I am your pet companion. Let us have a lovely day together.
Use your keyboard’s microphone to dictate, then review and send.
History could not be saved. Replies remain in memory; keep the app open.
What would you like to talk about?
Configure a model service before your first message. Messages are sent to your selected provider.
Messages are sent to the selected service. The API key is encrypted on this device and excluded from chat history.
A key is saved for this service. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a replacement.
This service needs its own key. Keys from other services are not reused.
Could not load history. The original file is retained. You can retry.
Could not save the language. Please retry.
Could not load model settings. Check or save them again.
Enter an API key for this service. Keys are not reused across services.
Check the HTTPS base URL, model name and numeric ranges.
Save failed. The key was not stored as plain text. Please retry.
Could not delete the key. Check the address or retry.
Send failed. Your draft is retained. Please retry.
Retry failed. Please try again later.
A reply is already generating. Stop it or wait.
Message too long. Use at most 12,000 characters.
Save a service address, model and key in model settings first.
Only the latest eligible unfinished reply can be retried.
Could not save the message. No request was sent; your draft is retained.
Authentication failed. Check the key and service permissions.
Request timed out. Check your network and retry.
Invalid reply format or reply too long.
